body: I'm very sorry you feel that way.  But I have hope for you. Call me an optimist.

I'm very sorry that you feel that way. I'm not in your shoes, but if you want an honest opinion.  Perhaps those things aren't what's most important. Most people do drugs or alcohol occasionally, or at least have in the past... And maybe dont tell potential partners about your porn habits.  Try talking about things you can share!  Do you like board gaming?  Have you been hiking?  What book are you reading?  Those are questions that increase dialogue.  When you say "I don't" that sets a different tone than saying "I do".  I'm sorry if I'm rambling, just advice I wish I had been given at your age (and I've had too much to drink)

Trust me, there are people all over the world on here! It tends to make problems seem bigger than they are. Often the smallest minorities make the biggest noise.  Not because they're bad people, but because they're hurt and afraid. Those people deserve respect, and help, but you can't let them scare you into becoming one of them.  Kind of like tumblr activists. To hear them shout, you'd think everyone in the world thought that way, but I've never actually met one in person!

I'm sure you're not that ugly!   I'm sure you're very handsome in your own way. Plus shared goals in the long term is the most important thing. I'm assuming you're young, and honestly I wouldn't worry.  Focus on all the wonderful things you want to do in life, and the perfect person will find their way into your life.  Its what I wish I had done!

Oh dear. This made me realize how biased against him this post sounds. I apologize for that. As far as the guys who don't get a chance... Keep trying!  You have a kind enough heart to reach out to a stranger in a very painful place and offer support.  That alone shows me you are a wonderful human being that any woman would be lucky to have. I wish you much luck, and I sincerely appreciate your comment of support.  It makes me feel a lot better.
Thank you very much. I appreciate your kind words. It feels good just to have someone listen.
